description: Review points found while writing this guide (code read on 2026-11-04)

data.title: A rerun node can pass with the previous generation's artifact
data.detail: On a reopen, artifact files stay on disk and the gate only checks `is_file()` [[src-absent]]. `artifactDigests` is recorded but never compared with the previous generation, so a worker that forgets to rewrite `plan.md` still passes. Fix: refuse approval when a stale node's artifact digest equals its last approved digest, unless the controller passes `--unchanged-ok`.

data.title: Receipt ignores the contents of new untracked files
data.detail: The subject digest hashes HEAD, `git diff HEAD` and only the **names** of untracked files [[src-subject]]. Editing a newly created (untracked) file after final-review does not break the receipt. Fix: hash each untracked file's content, or `git add -N` the intended paths first.

data.title: Node inputs are implicit
data.detail: A token says a predecessor is done, but the packet lists only the node's own outputs [[src-dispatch-id]]. A unit finds `plan.md` or `investigation.md` by convention. Fix: derive an `inputs` list per node (token → producer's artifacts, see the token table) and render it into the packet.

data.title: Artifact shape is prose-only
data.detail: Required sections (`## Confirmed cause`, `## Condition → negative case`, `## Rule self-check`) live in node cards; the gate does not parse them. Fix: add `requiredSections` to node specs and check headings at the gate.

data.title: No schema for graph/lifecycle.json, facts JSON or decision events
data.detail: Three of the contracts exist only as conventions; a typo in a graph key is silently ignored. Fix: add `graph.schema.json`, `facts.schema.json`, `decision-event.schema.json` and validate on load.

data.title: Profile validation is lighter than the schema
data.detail: The schema says `additionalProperties: false`, but the built-in check does not enforce it [[src-profile-schema]]. Fix: validate with `jsonschema` when available, fall back to the light check.

data.title: Read commands write state
data.detail: `status` and `plan` call `save()` [[src-plan-save]] to add records for nodes that newly entered the trace. Harmless today, but it makes a read a write. Fix: add missing records only in `handback`/`init`.

data.title: Decision log is not tamper-evident
data.detail: `decisions.jsonl` is append-only by convention and never read back [[src-log]]. Fix: add `prevDigest` per line (hash chain) and verify it in `status`.
